extension.name: Photobooth Operator Edition
isolation_policy: Never call upstream api/*.php via internal HTTP to chain operator workflows.
Never include upstream endpoint scripts inside custom operator controllers.
Never send finalized printable JPEGs through upstream api/print.php.
Never expose upstream /api/* or /admin/* on the guest LAN listener.
controlled_update_procedure: 1. Fetch upstream tags only (do not track dev branch).
2. Diff api/takePic.php, api/previewCamera.php, lib/config.php, and vendor submodules.
3. Run custom/bin/ci-check.sh (PHPUnit, pytest, Playwright, and upstream smoke lint).
4. Update commit_sha in custom/upstream.json only after all M0-M4 gates pass.
